payload.title: Newsroom board on phones: check on a real phone with real data
payload.description: Remaining acceptance from PPY-7a9355, which shipped in AnthusAI/Papyrus#1156 on develop. These need a real device or real newsroom data, so they could not be checked in headless runs. On a real phone against a deployed newsroom: the stacked board fits between the top bar and bottom navigation with the safe-area inset, with no double scrolling; long stages page in as the reader scrolls on real data, not just the fixture; opening a card and closing it returns to the same card and scroll position; collapsed sections persist; landscape shows the horizontal board. Needs Papyrus promoted to main, or a preview deployment of develop.
